item.description:
Build 431: answer Claude Code permission prompts from a Devkitty panel

  • Claude Code permission prompts can be answered from a Devkitty panel. It is off by default. Turn it on in Settings, Claude Code, or search permission in Cmd-P.
  • Each waiting prompt gets its own card. Return answers Yes after a short guard. Tab and the arrow keys move focus. Esc, the close button or a click outside leaves the prompt in the terminal.
  • A card shows the command, Claude's description and the text of the hook that asked, for example Tego.
  • An https link in a card switches to the tab of that question and opens the page in a split beside its terminal.
  • File edits and overlong commands have no Yes button. Answer those in the terminal.
  • New Claude Code settings page with permission prompts and conversation titles.
  • Limit: works with Claude Code only.
